name: Arm Circles
how_to:
1. Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, arms extended out to your sides at shoulder height.
2. Engage your core and keep your spine neutral to maintain good posture.
3. Begin making small forward circles with your arms, gradually increasing the size.
4. Perform for 20–30 seconds, then reverse the direction for the same duration.
5. Lower your arms and shake them out after completing both directions.
